tasks.title: src/utils.ts — collapse data-dir tier and delete temp-file resolvers
tasks.description: Remove all 7 markers in src/utils.ts. Delete dataDirNameAt and warnIfLegacyDataDir outright; rewrite findDataDir(projectRoot) to a plain existence check on join(projectRoot, BRAND.dataDir) — the function KEEPS its name and signature, since callers still need a resolved data dir. In findProjectRoot, the upward walk now tests BRAND.dataDir directly at each level; keep CAIRN_PROJECT_ROOT as priority #1 and the git-root/cwd fallbacks unchanged, and drop the legacy note from the doc comment. Delete findTempFilePath and allTempFilePaths ENTIRELY. This task depends on tasks 55 and 56, which migrated all five external callers (task-selector.ts, tasks-file.ts, task-archiver.ts, commands/logs.ts, commands/run.ts) — before deleting, verify with `grep -rn "findTempFilePath\|allTempFilePaths" src/ test/` that nothing outside src/utils.ts and test/utils.test.ts still references them. If anything does, STOP and report rather than deleting: the health check runs before every iteration, so a broken build stalls the whole loop. Keep tempFilePath and the surrounding 'Runtime temp files' comment, minus the dual-read framing. Drop the LEGACY/warnLegacyOnce imports. TDD: update test/utils.test.ts (delete the legacy-fallback describes and the findTempFilePath/allTempFilePaths blocks) and test/index.test.ts's two behavioral tests, 'falls back to an existing legacy .ralph/ data dir' and 'points completedTasksPath at a legacy .ralph/ data dir'. Watch fail, make pass. Do NOT modify cairn.json's healthCheck and do NOT run ./install.sh. Do not touch .cairn/tasks.completed.json, .cairn_iterations.log, .cairn_tasks_snapshot.json, .cairn/reviews/round-*.md, .ralph_task_*_notes.md, or audit/.
tasks.notes:
# Task #58 — src/utils.ts: collapse data-dir tier, delete temp-file resolvers

## Outcome

All 7 `remove once all projects migrated` markers in `src/utils.ts` are gone; the
file no longer imports `LEGACY` or `warnLegacyOnce` (only `BRAND`).

Pre-delete verification, as the task required:
`grep -rn "findTempFilePath\|allTempFilePaths" src/ test/` → only `src/utils.ts`
and `test/utils.test.ts`. Tasks 55/56 had indeed migrated all five external
callers, so deletion was safe. Post-change sweep for all four deleted symbols →
no stale references anywhere.

TDD: wrote/rewrote the tests first as **positive assertions that the legacy tier is
gone** (rather than only deleting tests, which can never go red), ran them against
the still-dual-reading source → **4 fail**, then made the source change → green.

- `bun test test/utils.test.ts test/index.test.ts` → **50 pass, 0 fail**
- `bun test` → **838 pass, 0 fail, 31 files** (down from #57's 849 — exactly the
  11 net tests removed, see accounting below; no regressions)
- `test/legacy-markers.test.ts` → passes within the full run
- Health check `bun build --target=bun src/index.ts --outfile /tmp/cairn-healthcheck`
  → OK. Did **not** touch `cairn.json`'s `healthCheck`; did **not** run `./install.sh`.

## src/utils.ts

- **Deleted** `dataDirNameAt` and `warnIfLegacyDataDir` outright.
- **`findDataDir(projectRoot)`** keeps its name and signature but collapses to a
  one-liner: `return join(projectRoot, BRAND.dataDir)`. Note the task text said
  "plain existence check" — with only one candidate left, *both* branches of that
  check return the identical path, so the check is provably dead code. The
  one-liner is behaviorally identical to an existence-checking version. Callers
  still route through this helper, so the standing "never build data paths from
  `BRAND.dataDir` directly" rule still has a single enforcement point.
- **`findProjectRoot`** — the upward walk now does
  `statSync(join(dir, BRAND.dataDir)).isDirectory()` inline at each level.
  **The `isDirectory()` semantics are deliberately preserved**: a plain
  `existsSync` would make a stray `.cairn` *file* stop the walk at the wrong
  directory. `CAIRN_PROJECT_ROOT` stays priority #1; git-root and cwd fallbacks
  unchanged; legacy note dropped from the doc comment.
- **Deleted** `findTempFilePath` and `allTempFilePaths` entirely. `tempFilePath`
  and the `── Runtime temp files ──` banner stay, minus the dual-read framing.
- `statSync` import retained (now used by `findProjectRoot`); `existsSync`
  retained (used by `resolveCairnRoot`).

## test/utils.test.ts

- Dropped `findTempFilePath`/`allTempFilePaths` from the import line, and the
  `resetLegacyWarnings` import (no utils code path emits legacy warnings now).
- **First `findProjectRoot` describe**: renamed the `.ralph` fixtures to `.cairn`.
  These were *not* cosmetic — they are behavioral assertions that would have gone
  red once the legacy leg was removed, so they had to move in this task even
  though task 64 owns the cosmetic fixture sweep. Task 64 will find them done.
- Deleted the whole `findProjectRoot — dual-read data directory discovery`
  describe (7 tests). Two of its tests were duplicates of the renamed ones above;
  the coverage worth keeping was rehomed into the first describe as:
  - `ignores a .cairn entry that is not a directory` (guards the `isDirectory()`
    semantics; restructured as parent-`.cairn`-dir / child-`.cairn`-file so it
    actually discriminates instead of passing via the cwd fallback)
  - `does not treat a legacy .ralph/ directory as a project root` (nearest-wins
    case, inverted — this was one of the 4 red tests)
- `findDataDir` describe: deleted the two legacy tests, added
  `never resolves to a legacy .ralph directory` (red before the change).
  Dropped the now-pointless `console.error` stubbing / `resetLegacyWarnings`.
- `runtime temp file paths` → renamed to `tempFilePath` with 2 tests; the
  `findTempFilePath` (4) and `allTempFilePaths` (1) blocks are gone.

## test/index.test.ts

- Deleted `falls back to an existing legacy .ralph/ data dir`, replaced with
  `never resolves to a leftover .ralph/ directory` (same fixture, inverted
  expectation — red before the change).
- `points completedTasksPath at a legacy .ralph/ data dir` → rewritten as
  `points completedTasksPath at .cairn/ even when a leftover .ralph/ exists`.
- **Scope note (beyond the two tests named in the task):** also deleted
  `prefers .cairn/ when both layouts exist`. It still passed, but "both layouts"
  is no longer a concept that exists — the test asserted a *preference* between
  two candidates where only one candidate remains. Renamed
  `defaults to .cairn/ when neither layout exists` →
  `...when the data dir does not exist yet` for the same reason.

Test-count accounting for 849 → 838: utils.test.ts −10 (−7 dual-read describe,
+2 rehomed; −2 findDataDir legacy, +1 inverted; −5 temp-file, +2 tempFilePath),
index.test.ts −1 (−2 deleted, +1 inverted).

## Notes for future tasks

- **Task 63 (`src/brand.ts` — delete LEGACY):** `LEGACY.tempPrefix` now has zero
  readers in `src/` — `src/utils.ts` was its last consumer. `LEGACY.dataDir` is
  still referenced by `src/commands/migrate.ts` and by `src/index.ts:189`
  (migrate's help text), both of which task 60 deletes. So 60 should land before 63.
- **Task 64 (cosmetic fixture sweep):** `test/utils.test.ts` and the data-dir
  portion of `test/index.test.ts` are already clean of `.ralph` fixtures; the only
  remaining `.ralph` strings there are in the two intentional *negative* tests
  (`never resolves to a legacy .ralph directory`, `never resolves to a leftover
  .ralph/ directory`), which must keep the literal to mean anything. Do not
  "clean" those.
- No discovered tasks this iteration — the task matched the codebase exactly.

tasks.title: Delete test/legacy-markers.test.ts
tasks.description: Delete test/legacy-markers.test.ts. It exists to guarantee every legacy fallback carries the 'remove once all projects migrated' marker so this removal round could be mechanical; with every fallback now gone it has nothing left to enforce. BEFORE deleting, run `grep -rn "remove once all projects migrated" src/ lib/ install.sh` and confirm the only remaining hits are in src/brand.ts (the LEGACY object, handled by task 63). If any other file still carries a marker, STOP and report rather than deleting — that means an earlier task left work behind. This task is deliberately ordered BEFORE the src/brand.ts task, inverting what the planning notes originally said. The reason: deleting LEGACY forces a hardcoded '.ralph_' literal for the permanent .ralph_task_<id>_notes.md scratch exception, and this test fails on that unmarked mention — which would leave task 63 with a red suite and get it reverted to in-progress by the post-iteration validator. Tasks 51-61 only REMOVE marked mentions and can never introduce an unmarked one, so the guardrail has no remaining work. Do NOT modify cairn.json's healthCheck and do NOT run ./install.sh. Do not touch .cairn/tasks.completed.json, .cairn_iterations.log, .cairn_tasks_snapshot.json, .cairn/reviews/round-*.md, .ralph_task_*_notes.md, or audit/.

Then repoint the three consumers: src/commands/run.ts:52 (buildSystemPrompt's notesFile), src/commands/run.ts:367 (NOTES_TEMPFILE_RE — the sweep must keep matching this prefix or scratch leaks forever; it can now match NOTES_TEMP_PREFIX alone, since .cairn_task_*_notes.md was never written), and src/commands/init.ts's surviving .ralph_task_*_notes.md gitignore line. Fix the now-stale comments at run.ts ~364 and ~711. tasks.title: Decide the fate of resolveAnthropicApiKeyChain — no production callers remain
tasks.description: Task #51 deleted warnIfLegacyApiKey and its two call sites (src/commands/narrate.ts, src/commands/run.ts), which were the only consumers of resolveAnthropicApiKeyChain(). The function is still exported from src/config.ts and covered by test/config.test.ts, but nothing in src/ calls it — the resolution is now purely documentary, mirroring the same chain in lib/cairn_narrate_server.py (see task #59). Either (a) delete the helper, its AnthropicApiKeyResolution type, and its tests, leaving the Python server as the single implementation, or (b) keep it and give it a real caller — e.g. have runNarrate/runRun pass the resolved key into the narration server env instead of relying on the child process re-reading the environment. Do NOT normalize onto plain ANTHROPIC_API_KEY under either option: the loop deliberately blanks that name to force Max-plan usage. Sequence this after #59 so both sides of the mirror are decided together.
